applies_why: This judge text decides the Isaiah 7:14 link by asking whether the sign itself states the mechanism, which is the verse-by-verse/stating-verse move K-C governs.
quote: the sign itself does not state the mechanism.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse: either it permits finding a link underdetermined because the sign verse itself does not state the mechanism, or it requires the pressing side's chain to be weighed against the defending chain by footing rather than by what the sign alone states.
why: The judge's underdetermined finding rests on what the sign itself says, not on a chain-against-chain footing comparison, so it uses the verse-by-verse/stating-verse test K-C forbids.
